rows.note: Use this for text shown on a film, video, or broadcast to represent dialogue or other sounds.

example.english: The caption on the video lets you follow it without sound.
example.traditional: 條片有字幕，冇聲都睇得明。
example.jyutping: tiu4 pin3 jau5 zi6 mok6 mou5 sing1 dou1 tai2 dak1 ming4

rows.note: Use this for the explanatory text attached to a photograph, illustration, cartoon, or interface image.

example.english: The caption under this photo gives the date it was taken.
example.traditional: 呢張相下面嘅圖片說明寫住拍攝日期。
example.jyutping: ni1 zoeng1 soeng2 haa6 min6 ge3 tou4 pin2 syut3 ming4 se2 zyu6 paak3 sip3 jat6 kei4

rows.note: Use this for a document heading or the title of one of its sections.

example.english: The caption of this report is too long; help me shorten it.
example.traditional: 呢份報告嘅標題太長，幫我改短啲。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 ge3 biu1 tai4 taai3 coeng4 bong1 ngo5 goi2 dyun2 di1
